sources.title: Wukong Build Guide: [League Classic 2026] My Place Is At The Top - Wukong Top/Mid/Jungle Revision!

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.text: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.text: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

spells.name: Warrior Trickster
spells.text: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

spells.name: Nimbus Strike
spells.text: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.text: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

archetype.value: Wukong is a durable fighter who thrives in extended fights.

axis.value: Wukong favors sustained fights over short burst trades.

spikes.why: Wukong can use its active to engage and catch targets.
Wukong becomes more durable, especially against physical damage.

mistakes.value: Wukong loses value from Youmuu's Ghostblade when he does not use its active.
